ranked.headline: Label-efficient training and input curation in biomedical segmentation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints favour patch selection, foundation models and uncertainty-aware segmentation that lessen reliance on dense manual annotation.

ranked.headline: Computational methods resolve spatial niches and perturbations in transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply neighborhood, perturbation and cross-platform annotation methods to Xenium, MERFISH and Visium HD data.

ranked.headline: Reconstructing aging trajectories from population tests to single-cell dynamics
ranked.summary: Population-scale laboratory records and single-cell expression models now enable aging trajectories to be inferred across biological scales.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools standardise omics data formats, preprocessing and interactive analysis
ranked.summary: Recent releases emphasise usability and format handling, lowering the programming burden for multimodal omics data analysis.

ranked.headline: Generative and guided models for designing proteins, antibodies, and small molecules
ranked.summary: Structure-aware generative models now couple energy, physics, and hallucination guidance to protein, antibody, and ligand design.

ranked.headline: Single-cell atlases link cell-type regulatory maps to disease and 3D genome structure
ranked.summary: Cell-type atlases now integrate hundreds of individuals and multi-omic regulatory maps, with public resources released alongside.

ranked.headline: Open Python tools and deep learning models target omics variant and expression analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release benchmarked Python and deep-learning tools for regulome, expression, and single-cell omics analysis.

ranked.headline: Compact sequence indexes and alignment-free methods scale microbial genome comparison
ranked.summary: Compact k-mer, minimizer, and sketch representations are now being paired with compressed and pretrained models for genome-scale microbial analysis.

ranked.headline: Multimodal and hybrid models infer toxicity and survival from chemical perturbation data
ranked.summary: Expanded toxicogenomic and bioactivity resources, such as DILImap and Tox21, now allow data-driven models of toxicity and survival.

ranked.headline: Computational models benchmarked against folding, aggregation and selection data
ranked.summary: Mega-scale folding, aggregation and selection datasets now enable direct experimental testing of sequence and structure-based predictors.

ranked.headline: Neural sequence models link DNA sequence to regulatory activity and expression
ranked.summary: Multimodal masking, wavelet encodings, and preference tuning extend sequence models to chromatin, binding, and personal expression tasks.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings fused with structure, text, and homolog context
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published model pair protein language model embeddings with 3D structure, binding sites, chemical encoders, or homolog retrieval.

ranked.headline: Physics-informed and learned models capture biomolecular kinetics and ensemble dynamics
ranked.summary: Learned models now target kinetics, free energies, and metastable states rather than single static structures.

ranked.headline: New computational RNA sequencing methods resolve splicing, alleles and RNA modifications
ranked.summary: Recent studies test RNA sequencing analysis methods against reference or simulated data, from single-cell splicing to nanopore modification calling.

ranked.headline: Large sequence models are being applied to RNA design and protein function prediction
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence models are moving from sequence prediction toward design validated by translation and therapeutic readouts.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks test LLM agents and network inference methods on transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study benchmark network inference, simulation, and LLM-based annotation methods against deterministic baselines.

ranked.headline: MD simulations resolve loop dynamics, allosteric rewiring and lipid scrambling mechanisms
ranked.summary: Large-scale MD now quantifies conformational behavior of CDR loops, spike allostery, and lipid scrambling that static structures miss.

ranked.headline: Learned and foundation-model segmentation adapted to cryoEM, cryoET, and microscopy
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply self-supervised, fine-tuned, and training-free models directly to raw cryo-EM, cryo-ET, and microscopy images.

ranked.headline: Computational methods uncover RNA-chromatin artifacts and new RNA processing sites
ranked.summary: Recent work tests RNA-centric computational inference against experimental artifacts and applies it to large-scale profiling.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking docking and MD workflows for PROTAC ternary complexes and lncRNA targets
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks test physics-based and ML docking on PROTAC ternary complexes while automated pipelines expand structure-based virtual screening.

ranked.headline: Marker-guided selection of genomes, markers and assemblies before downstream analysis
ranked.summary: Expanding public genome and metagenome collections make selecting marker-defined subsets before analysis a practical alternative to processing whole datasets.

ranked.headline: Long-read evidence resolves misassemblies, haplotype switch errors and phasing gaps
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply long-read alignment features and DNA methylation linkage to assembly error detection and haplotype phasing accuracy.

ranked.headline: Viscoelastic aging and sticker-spacer models explain condensate material properties
ranked.summary: Simulation and imaging preprints from November 2025 quantify how condensate viscosity, aging, and phosphorylation kinetics govern material state.

ranked.headline: Microstructure-informed models link tissue anisotropy to mechanical behavior
ranked.summary: Recent preprints tie myofibril, cartilage, and skin microstructure to constitutive parameters, with inverse identification as a route to in vivo properties.

ranked.headline: Simulations resolve supercoiling and promoter effects on bacterial transcription
ranked.summary: Computational models now dissect supercoiling, promoter architecture, and nascent RNA read generation in bacterial transcription.

ranked.headline: Proteome-scale prediction of interactions, disordered grammars and functional segments
ranked.summary: Predicted structures and protein language model embeddings now enable systematic annotation and interaction inference across the human proteome.

ranked.headline: Statistical and unsupervised frameworks target mediation, methylation and chromatin QTLs
ranked.summary: A 280,000-cell immune scATAC map finds caQTLs explain about 50% more GWAS loci than eQTLs, sharpening regulatory interpretation of disease variants.

ranked.headline: Persistent homology and Grassmann manifolds applied to single-cell and spatial data
ranked.summary: Topology-informed multiscale methods now target spatial domains and single-cell embeddings, with reported gains over clustering baselines.

ranked.headline: Genome mining resolves defense, prophage, and strain diversity in gut bacteria
ranked.summary: Population-scale genome mining now resolves gut bacterial defense systems, prophages, and clinical strain structure.

ranked.headline: Nonlinear EEG measures and modelling track sleep, consciousness and cognitive state
ranked.summary: Nonlinear complexity measures, mechanistic whole-brain models and adaptive stimulation are now being applied jointly to human EEG and iEEG.

ranked.headline: Deep learning predicts mutational binding energetics, ligand sites, and docking pockets
ranked.summary: Graph and structural neural networks now target interface mutation energetics, ligand binding residues, and pocket localization for docking.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics links gene loss and recombination suppression to speciation
ranked.summary: Recent comparisons across 154 animal genomes and 94 mammal species link specific genomic features to terrestrial colonization and speciation outcomes.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of regulatory programs from single-cell transcriptomes
ranked.summary: Marker scoring and mechanistic dynamical models now extract regulatory and cellular structure from transcriptomic measurements at single-cell and bulk…

ranked.headline: LLM and graph-based tools for drug repositioning, literature mining, and spectra
ranked.summary: November 2025 preprints extend deep-learning, graph, and language-model methods to repositioning, literature graphs, and MS/MS simulation.

ranked.headline: Software tools target DIA proteomics, MS metadata and multiplex imaging annotation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address validation, metadata capture and consensus labelling in proteomic and multiplex imaging analysis.

ranked.headline: Emergent structure governs survival and stability in ecosystems, cells and agent flocks
ranked.summary: Three recent preprints recast survival and stability constraints as the organizing objects of complex-system analysis.

ranked.headline: Canalization opens a coherence gap between attractors and basins in gene networks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints formalize how feedback strength and canalization set attractor stability and lineage-induction trajectories in regulatory circuits.

ranked.headline: Local mechanochemical and crowding rules set glassy and self-assembly dynamics in cells
ranked.summary: Current preprints link explicit local feedback and adhesion rules to emergent glassy and self-assembly behavior in epithelia and cell populations.
